sources.название: Emulation of the Drosophila Fly Brain
sources.задача: Whole-brain LIF simulation and backend benchmarking
sources.метод: Brian2, Brian2CUDA, PyTorch, NEST GPU and GeNN
sources.кросс_субъект: Not applicable; no population-level validation reported
sources.ограничения: Repository implementation; code was inspected but not executed locally; no nociception, pain, ECAP or human-transfer validation

validation.notes: Official repository and README inspected at the pinned commit. GPL-2.0 metadata confirmed. Repository claims are not treated as independent biological validation.

relations.note: Repository states that its canonical Brian2 model is based on the published Drosophila computational brain model.

sources.модальность: Connectome-derived spiking neural activity and synthetic sensory stimulation
sources.задача: Sparse snnTorch implementation of the adult fruit-fly brain model
sources.метод: snnTorch dense and sparse LIF simulation
sources.датасет: Adult Drosophila connectome inputs inherited from the upstream model
sources.кросс_субъект: Not applicable; no population-level validation reported
sources.ограничения: Repository demonstrations and charts were not independently reproduced; sensory encoders are engineering inputs, not validated natural transduction or pain labels

validation.notes: Official repository and README inspected at the pinned commit. MIT license metadata confirmed; runtime reproduction remains pending.

relations.note: README describes this repository as an snnTorch port of the Brian2 implementation.

sources.название: FlyGym: Simulating embodied sensorimotor control with NeuroMechFly v2
sources.модальность: Biomechanics, vision, olfaction, mechanosensory feedback and movement
sources.задача: Embodied sensorimotor simulation of adult Drosophila
sources.метод: FlyGym 2.x and NeuroMechFly v2 on MuJoCo/MJWarp
sources.кросс_субъект: Not applicable; model variability must be introduced explicitly
sources.ограничения: Software framework, not a nociception benchmark; version 2.x is not backward-compatible with 1.x and lacks pain, ECAP and SCS targets

validation.notes: Official repository and README inspected at the pinned commit; Apache-2.0 and v2.1.0 release metadata confirmed. Code was not executed locally.

relations.note: Official code repository for the FlyGym/NeuroMechFly v2 publication (DOI 10.1038/s41592-024-02497-y).

sources.название: FLYBOX: an open-source connectome sandbox for a simulated fruit-fly nervous system
sources.модальность: Connectome-derived neural activity, sandbox events and simulated behavior
sources.метод: FlyBrain/MaleCNS simulation with FastAPI and React sandbox
sources.ограничения: Experimental encoders and decoders; repository explicitly disclaims complete biological simulation, natural behavior, cognition and consciousness; runtime not reproduced locally

validation.notes: Repository and README inspected at the pinned commit. Apache-2.0 metadata confirmed; scientific behavior was not independently reproduced.
